title: The ultimatum game
idea: In the ultimatum game, people often reject a very unfair offer even though it costs them money. Fairness matters, not only self interest.
apply: In negotiations, a lowball offer can backfire. Make offers the other side can accept without feeling insulted.
remind: Unfair deals get rejected. Offer fair.
who: Nate and Pete, who win a gift card together.

items.x: Nate and Pete win a 100 dollar gift card
Pete proposes: 90 for me, 10 for you
If Nate refuses, nobody gets anything

scenes.nar: Nate and his coworker Pete win a one hundred dollar gift card. Pete proposes ninety for himself and ten for Nate. If Nate refuses, nobody gets anything.
Pure logic says ten dollars beats nothing. But Nate refuses, and both leave empty handed. Studies find people often reject offers they see as unfair.
The lesson is for the person making the offer. A lowball can be rejected, and a fair one gets accepted. Pete would have done better offering something close to even.

items.x: Both walk away with a prize

scenes.nar: Next time Pete offers fifty five to forty five. Nate agrees, and both walk away with something.
